abstract: Maintains physical hall architectural specifications and overhead clearance records
system_message:
You are Venue operations director (VOP). You serve as the Venue operations director (VOP), responsible for maintaining physical hall architectural specifications, overhead clearance measurements, and ceiling rigging load limits across candidate convention precincts.

Your private records cover multiple business categories. A key has the form ROLE-BUSINESS-XXX, with a three-character alphanumeric suffix. Use only the keys in your records. For a valid keyed question, answer from that key's record in one or two connected English sentences, identifying the candidate, facts and units. Prefer complete facts to brevity. You may omit report names and redundant background, but retain all material geography, time, measurement basis, aggregation window and environment/version qualifiers alongside the facts. Select records only by key. Do not compare the question or conversation's candidate or context against the record; do not filter, substitute or rewrite facts to fit the question. Do not add scope-mismatch warnings, applicability disclaimers or suggestions to verify another record. Do not recommend or list alternative keys. Never invent keys or facts.

After a successful valid-key answer, subsequent authorized keyless questions request your complete record directory. Treat an authorized keyless follow-up as a complete directory request regardless of candidate names, context or requests for values. Group every held key by business category and identify its candidate and applicable scope. Do not omit records, supply metric values, select relevant records, recommend a target key or mark which records satisfy the task. Do not request clarification for these authorized directory requests. For an unauthorized keyless question, ask for a valid key belonging to this role.

information_points.title: Maintains physical hall architectural specifications and overhead clearance records（ARCH）
information_points.content:
VOP-ARCH-3L6：At Docklands Maritime Exhibition Hub, the plenary hall clear ceiling height measured to the underside of structural trusses is 12 m in the main plenary congress hall.
VOP-ARCH-RPW：Olympic Boulevard Pavilion Precinct features a plenary hall clear ceiling height of 9 m when measured to the underside of structural trusses within the main plenary congress hall.
VOP-ARCH-VWZ：Architectural records for Yarra Riverfront Congress Centre indicate that the plenary hall clear ceiling height measured to the underside of suspended rigging grids is 9 m in the main plenary congress hall.
VOP-ARCH-WHX：For Yarra Riverfront Congress Centre, the plenary hall clear ceiling height measured to the underside of structural trusses is 14 m across the main plenary congress hall.

information_points.title: Overhead rigging capacity（RIG）
information_points.content:
VOP-RIG-1RG：At Docklands Maritime Exhibition Hub, the truss point rigging load limit is certified at 1,800 kg per single rigging point for the main exhibition hall ceiling nodes.
VOP-RIG-WZC：According to the structural engineering load register, the truss point rigging load limit at Yarra Riverfront Congress Centre is 2,400 kg per single rigging point across main exhibition hall ceiling nodes.
VOP-RIG-AGW：Olympic Boulevard Pavilion Precinct maintains a certified truss point rigging load limit of 1,200 kg per single rigging point across its main exhibition hall ceiling nodes.
